name: telegram-approvals
description: Send Claude Code notifications and approve or deny tool requests from Telegram.

bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
bot_token.description: Token issued by BotFather for a dedicated bot.

chat_id.title: Telegram chat ID

allowed_user_ids.title: Allowed Telegram user IDs

approval_timeout.title: Approval timeout
